snippet.title: Humanity Echo - Cyberpunk Tactical RPG | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Humanity Echo: Cyberpunk Tactical RPG - Official Trailer (Turn-Based, Cover & AP)

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3865080/Humanity_Echo_Cyberpunk_Tactical_RPG/
Itch.io: https://sympathy-systems.itch.io/humanity-echo

A squad-based, turn-based tactics RPG set in a living cyberpunk city. Scout districts, prep the op with gadgets and traps, then fight smart on a grid with cover, overwatch, and stealth. Your choices visibly reshape the map: district control, vendors, patrols, events.

Timespamps:
00:07 - Deep tactical combat
00:14 - Inventory and skills
00:26 - Grenade usage
00:32 - City map & locations
00:35 - Dialogue with character
00:41 - Mission preview
00:47 - Enemy reinforcements

Key features:
Turn-based tactics on a grid with cover and overwatch
Squad loadouts & implants instead of fixed classes
Prep phase: sabotage, bribes, support, trap placement
Consequences on the city map after every mission
Story-rich “warm cyberpunk”: neon + human stakes

#HumanityEcho #TacticalRPG #Cyberpunk
